positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:

• Agile diagnosis and debugging of live trading system in response to changing vendor specifications and stakeholder needs

• Rapid achievement of proficiency with unfamiliar development tools to facilitate repair and replacement of legacy systems

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer

• Adapted internet routing algorithm to target specific zip codes for ad delivery based on IP address

• Regular team consultation to perform code review, translate requirements, specify metrics and measurements, provide initial quality assurance, and support Operations group during software deployment

projects.title: Independent Exploration Sabbatical
projects.description:
I took the opportunity for a mid-career break and pursued independent projects with an emphasis on self-reliance, new skills, personal growth, and gaining a broader perspective.

• Offshore sailing building competence in energy independence, mechanical systems, and contingency planning. I explored the Bahamas, Turks and Caicos, Dominican Republic, and east coast of the US in a small sailing yacht.

• Endurance athletics focusing on the physical and mental health aspects including nutrition and mindfulness based mental discipline. I completed an ultra marathon finishing 12th of 82 competitors.

• Traveling extensively valuing spontaneity, unique experiences, and independent navigation of logistical challenges. 

• Primary hospice caregiver for aging relative suffering complications from Parkinson’s and dementia

• Personal asset management and budgeting for financial independence during extended sabbatical
